title: Levitation
caption: Levitation (V)
game_text:
USED: Take a droid or device from your Force Pile into hand; reshuffle.
LOST: Once per game, if your apprentice is on Dagobah, cancel a Force drain at a non-Dagobah location.
lore: Telekinesis is one of the powers awakened during a Jedi’s apprenticeship. Using this ability, a student of the Force can learn to levitate objects.
